blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Face-to-face classes in public and private schools at all levels in Manila are suspended on Monday, Sept. 21, due to security concerns over rallies and other activities marking the 54th anniversary of the declaration of Martial Law. Manila Mayor Francisco “Isko Moreno” Domagoso announced the suspension on Sunday, noting that it was based on the recommendation of the Manila Police District (MPD).
